items.title: General Electric (GE) Lands Record 1,000 Plus Engine Deal Through CFM And IndiGo
items.summary: IndiGo has signed a record-setting memorandum of understanding for more than 1,000 LEAP-1A engines with CFM International, a joint venture that includes General Electric's GE Aerospace unit. The agreement supports IndiGo's largest ever fleet expansion and includes a long-term partnership for maintenance, repair, overhaul and material services. This is the largest single engine order in CFM's history and further embeds GE Aerospace technology across India's fast growing commercial aviation...
